questions.question: What is noise pollution, and how can it affect people?
questions.expected_answer: Noise pollution is loud or unwanted sound that disturbs people or animals or harms their health. It can make it hard to concentrate and sleep, cause headaches and stress, and very loud sound can damage hearing.

questions.question: Why is hearing damage from loud noise permanent?
questions.expected_answer: Deep inside the ear are tiny hair cells that bend when sound reaches them and send messages to the brain. Very loud sounds can damage or break these hair cells, and they do not grow back, so the hearing that is lost cannot be recovered.

questions.question: Give four ways to protect your hearing.
questions.expected_answer: Any four, for example: keep the volume of radios, phones and earphones low; take quiet breaks from noise; move away from loud sounds and speakers; wear earplugs or earmuffs in loud places; cover your ears when a loud sound comes; do not make loud noises next to other people's ears.
